title: An anomaly project's alerts are reviewed on the project page
request: The owner: continue by priority until tonight's full gate; 20.7 left the review list without a page.
spec: EXPERIENCE_AND_WORKFLOWS_PLAN.md 20.7: the review loop takes confirmed and rejected alerts through the API; no page showed the list or took the confirmations.
plan: Find where the review list lives
A panel on the project's Overview
A browser check on a real anomaly project

decisions.decision: Read the list from the project data the page already loads
decisions.why: the final stage's record holds it; no new route

decisions.decision: Unchecked alerts send nothing, and at least one confirmed case is required
decisions.why: the route makes the confirmed its labels; a review without one teaches nothing

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/project.html (the panel and its send), web/src/features.js, the generated frontend, scripts/browser_e2e.py (the review check), tests/test_web_client.py, the 20.7 plan status.

findings.defect: The new check could not find the server's workspace
findings.scenario: the script's server keeps its workspace as a temporary folder object
findings.cause: the object was used as a path

outcome: A person reviews an anomaly project's ranked alerts on its Overview; the ones confirmed become its labels, checked end to end in the browser.
lessons: A page for an existing route is done only when a browser check drives it on a real project.
risks: Rejected alerts stay reviewed, never negatives, as the route decides.
